name: SWIFT Customer Security Controls Framework (CSCF)
note: DRAFT. Control titles and requirement texts are placeholders: check them against the current CSCF published by SWIFT before using the tool for an audit. The requirement numbers (x.y.z) are internal to this tool.

requirements.text: SWIFT environment segregated from the general corporate network and from internet access
Operating system privileged accounts are restricted and controlled
Internet access from SWIFT components is restricted or blocked
Security patches are applied within defined timeframes
Hardening configuration is documented and applied to servers
Unnecessary services and ports are disabled
Periodic vulnerability scans are run on SWIFT components
Password policy meets minimum complexity and rotation requirements
Logical access is limited to the principle of least privilege
Anti-malware protection is active and up to date on all components
Security logs are collected and retained centrally
Security events are monitored and alerted
Cyber incident response plan is documented and tested
